dct_creator_sm: Canada Health Infoway (OTHER, Canada Health Infoway, Leger).
dct_description_sm: The 2016 National Survey of Community-Based Pharmacists: Use of Digital Health Technology in Practice dataset includes the positive impact that the use of digital health is having on Canadian pharmacists’ changing practice needs and on patient safety and the delivery of care. The survey was done by Canada Health Infoway and the Canadian Pharmacists Association.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
